quest.title: The Snowy Past
quest.description: Paimon, struck by a bout of imagination, drags you off to the alchemy store in Mondstadt to expound her bold hypothesis to Sucrose and Timaeus, but is told that the best person to answer such questions is, in fact, the scholarly Albedo. However, the person waiting for you there is...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: My camp is somewhere that we can talk openly without reservation. But before that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... What a mess...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can help tidy up.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Thank you. I appreciate it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, that should do it. Neat and tidy.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Thank you, both of you.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Now that everything is in order... it's time to talk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You look really serious right now... is this about what happened earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I remember I once told you that you must have questions, and that I would answer them.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I also said that, while I did not wish to deceive you, there were certain things I could not go into detail on.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I am a synthetic human being... a human forged by human hand. The one who created me, my mother and teacher, her name is Rhinedottir — a researcher from Khaenri'ah, also known as "Gold."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A synthetic human!? What the... how the heck does that work?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: When the pinnacle of attainment in alchemy is combined with unimaginably vast learning... the apex achievement is the creation of human life.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When you say Khaenri'ah, do you mean...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I am indeed somewhat older than my appearance might suggest. But when I came into being, Khaenri'ah had already been destroyed. I have no memories of it.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: My master raised me and taught me everything. Like her, I am a pure alchemist. I live for academic knowledge. Nationality and identity are not what ultimately define us.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Traveler, what is your general feeling toward Dragonspine? You've visited numerous times now. Would you say it's a... cold, eerie, and melancholy place?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Rhinedottir created two miraculous beings. One is me, and the other is the venomous dragon, Durin, who died here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Durin!? So that makes you guys... brothers?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: As sons of Rhinedottir, Durin and I are indeed inextricably linked to one another.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The phenomenon of our creation defies definition within the scope of a typical human worldview, but if we may tentatively call it "birth"... then yes — we, by extension, are family.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of Durin, Paimon remembers that his power was quite special...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A strange and tenacious life force.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: That's right.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Because of this, whenever strange things happen on Dragonspine, it always makes me wonder. For instance, the feeling of being watched that you described, as well as the sounds you heard... and the one impersonating me that Eula met...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About that. There's something else I couldn't say earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right! Paimon knows what you mean!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #When Eula and the others were here just now, {NICKNAME} gave me a look as if to say, "Don't say anything." Probably because it would only make you more suspicious. So Paimon kept quiet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon noticed that you came out of the cavern not too long after going in, and you told us that you didn't manage to catch the thief.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then, we heard Bennett calling for help so we went to rescue him. But strangely, you didn't come with us, and when we got back to the cavern to go find you, suddenly you were the one looking for us.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: So it seems that you met my impostor, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well if so, it was a pretty good impression... he had you down to a T. We never would've guessed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, after he left us, why did he go after Joel?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Perhaps, Durin's power drives people to madness... But that's merely crude conjecture.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Whether someone is impersonating me or there is another, false "me" out there... This is a cursed tale, and it is not one whose weight you should have to bear.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Traveler, perhaps you should return to Mondstadt if you have no further business here. The work that lies ahead will occupy me completely, I'm afraid I will be unable to entertain you beyond this point.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not going anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon and I will help with the investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! We're Dragonspine veterans by now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If there's something really bad going on, we can't just leave you here to deal with it all on your own. That wouldn't be very nice, now, would it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Besides, there's no one else in Mondstadt that you can talk to about this. Sucrose and Timaeus don't know your secret...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're the only ones who can help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Don't push us away at a time like this!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: ...Alright. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You were intending to participate in that winter camp, if I recall correctly? That could serve as an excellent pretext for you to remain on the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: In that case, please join in the activities of the Adventurers' Guild as planned, and be on the lookout for any leads while you're at it. If anyone sees "me," or someone like me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll be sure to pass the info straight onto you!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Good. Then we're agreed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, let's split up to look for clues, then meet back here at this camp in a few days' time!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Sounds good to me.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: But please, whatever happens, put your safety first at all times.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Here. More footprints.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're heading to the cavern? Ooh hoo-hoo, we got you now! You sure can run, but you definitely can't hide!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go in!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Wait, I have an idea.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I'll go in alone. Traveler, please stay here and guard the entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This cavern has two points of entry, and there are shortcuts inside. Judging from the state of the footprints, he hasn't been in there long. I should be able to reach the other side before he does.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cut him off at both ends. Good idea!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Whoever apprehends the thief first has to notify the other party. This way, we're fully covered.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Still, safety comes first. We do not yet know the identity of our thief. Please take care.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll be fine!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Okay. See you shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You take care, too!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I wonder if Albedo found the thief... This is taking forever...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He's not been that long.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Huh, maybe it just feels like a long time because Paimon hates waiting... Waiting is so boring.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we find something to do to pass the time? Y'know, something like... something like...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Look at all that Starsilver over there. Why don't we gather it up for Albedo?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's right next to the cavern, so we won't be going far. If anything happens inside, we can be right back here in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay, let's get started!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally, you're back!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then why is the thief not with you?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Sorry, I was unable to catch him. He was faster than I had imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: O—Oh... So, after all that, we still don't even know who the thief was... Ugh, what a waste.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, we won't be going back completely empty-handed. We did some mining!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Mining?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, for Starsilver! Look, we got quite a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's just like you said — some are really bright and shiny, and others just look like regular lumps of rock with a little shiny bit here or there.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: ...Starsilver...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Haha, I was merely saying what was on the front of my mind. I hadn't thought you would genuinely go and gather some.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, you said they can be turned into paint, so we got pretty curious!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, if it weren't for that thief, we'd be making paint by now anyway, right? Or even painting by this point.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway. It's all the thief's fault for wasting our time!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: ...Yes, it's all the thief's fault.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The notes mean a lot to me. I'm not quite ready to give up the search yet. Let's keep an eye out for clues as we go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, just one thing — do you want us to bring all of this ore back? Or did you wanna sort through and get rid of the useless bits first?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's no point bringing the bad ones back if it'll ruin the quality of the paint. Some of them do look pretty dull to Paimon, so it doesn't seem like those'll be of any use at all.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Indeed, the sorting process is necessary. Humans are such practical creatures. They only want those things that are good. Once they have learned to distinguish between good and bad, they will never stop comparing things in their minds.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Useless things should be disposed of at the outset.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, it saves a lot of time that way. Efficiency first! So let's start by...
...Help! Help me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, did you guys hear that? Was that... a cry for help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (That voice sounded very familiar!)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's likely an adventurer in danger!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go check it out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay!

talks.objective: Collect Starsilver at the cavern's entrance

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still no sign of Albedo. This is weird, where has he run off to?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: This is great, Dragonspine's so fun today! There's so many people around — it's never usually like this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This was where we heard Bennett's cry for help... right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Right.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We heard his voice and went straight over to rescue him. Then we noticed Albedo was gone... Huh! So he just... didn't feel like helping us save Bennett!?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Wait, what!?
What are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Albedo! Where the heck have you been? We've been looking for you!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I should be the one to ask you that. Didn't I tell you to stay at the cavern entrance?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'm not really following who was waiting for who, and who was looking for who... But, first things first!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I apologize, Albedo. I don't fully understand what's going on, but it seems like it's mostly my fault...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: No, no... Bennett, this is not because of you. You needn't blame yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Traveler, clear this up for me — what was the reason that you left the cavern entrance? Did you—
There you are!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Stay right there. You have a lot of explaining to do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Eula? Aren't you supposed to be helping the new guy?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Hmph, yes, that's what I would be doing — if I hadn't been interrupted by a certain someone's malicious scheming.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Albedo, I saw you taking Joel towards the wasteland at the edge of Dragonspine. That place is crawling with monsters. What the devil do you think you were doing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, wait a second... What's going on!? Actually, wrong question — how much stuff is going on...?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: When I came to stop you from leading Joel any further, your first reaction was to throw the child down and attack me. When I fought back, you quickly fled. Care to explain?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I see. Interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: "Interesting"?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Eula, it sounds like you met an impostor. Someone who was impersonating me.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Impersonating you...? To what end?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It is difficult to draw a definitive conclusion for now. But these strange incidents do seem to be connected.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Your alchemy notes were stolen? Can the Traveler and Paimon testify that the three of you were together up until you entered the cavern?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, we can confirm that.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: As things stand, I don't have any reason to harm the child. Whoever you met is likely to be both the thief who stole my notes and also an impostor.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Of course, it's entirely natural for you to be skeptical of my story.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I was separated from the Traveler and Paimon for a significant duration while we were pursuing the thief. My word alone cannot serve as a definitive account of my actions and whereabouts during that period.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: But the Traveler and Paimon can at least testify that I was not the individual who tore up the campsite or stole my notes.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Albedo, do you have any enemies? Could it be one of your enemies impersonating you to get revenge on you or something?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I don't have any enemies, and I'm not aware of having given anyone cause to exact vengeance upon me.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: There is insufficient evidence to assert what happened with any certainty at this point. Given how serious the situation is, I intend to investigate it myself, even if you decide not to pursue it any further.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Eula, I won't discourage your ongoing suspicion of me if you can't believe my story. Though naturally, I would hope you can afford me some credibility on account of our solidarity as fellow members of the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, Bennett, if you are willing, I welcome you to monitor my activities beyond this point so that you can act as my witnesses.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If I am what this impostor wants, he will come looking for me again eventually. Things can only become clearer from that point on.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I'll give you the benefit of the doubt, as preposterous as your claims sound, and I will choose to believe that an impostor went after Joel, and not you.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I will keep Joel safe. If you need any support with the investigation, contact myself and Amber.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You have my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: As far as Amber goes, I will...
Eula! EUUULAAA! Where are you!!!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Amber, we're here!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Eula! Oh, and Traveler, Paimon, Albedo, and Bennett, you're all together! Great!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Bennett, I'm glad I ran into you here. Cyrus was telling me you still hadn't shown up. He was getting worried you might've run into some trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha... Yeah, I ran into a little trouble... thanks for your concern.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Sure thing. Well, that now that I've found you, let's go check in with Cyrus.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: But before that — has something come up? How come you're all gathered here together? Need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Between us, there have been a few minor incidents. But nothing I haven't already dealt with.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh! Uh, yeah, hehe, it's my fault really, all because of my bad luck. But everything is fine now!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: So, it's all set then? Great. Shall we head back down together? I did say I'd bring Bennett back if I saw him.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Sure, I'm ready to go!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: ...Very well. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And then there were three.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Traveler, can we talk somewhere else? There is something I need to tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Let's go to my camp.

talks.objective: Collect Starsilver at the cavern's entrance

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, this should be enough... Some Starsilvers shine a lot more brightly than others, huh.

talks.objective: Chase the sounds to their source

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The voice was definitely coming from around here!
Is anybody there!? Help me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It sounds like...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way, is that...
Hmm? Is that the Traveler and Paimon!? It's me, Bennett!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's really him...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's get him out!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: So sorry to trouble you guys again... The key should be someplace nearby, please help me find it!

talks.objective: Find the key to the cage

dialogues.speaker: You examine the cavern entrance...
dialogues.text: The cavern entrance is rather narrow, and can barely allow one person to pass through at a time. Albedo has already gone within in pursuit of the culprit, so you might as well wait for him outside, just as he asked.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Finally, I'm out. Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: If only there hadn't been rocks mixed in with the snow on the tree, it wouldn't have made me all dizzy when it fell down onto my head, and then I would've never walked into the Fatui's trap...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bennett... in a cage... never saw that coming!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha, I won't bore you with the rest of the details. Just me being unlucky again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We drove off the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We got revenge for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep. Taking them out was child's play. No need to thank us!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You did? Hahahaha, that's so nice of you guys!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I know they were probably just following orders... but still, thanks for helping me out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So what are you doing on Dragonspine? Didn't Razor wanna come with you?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Did you hear about the Adventurers' Guild thing? They're hosting a winter camp here. As one of their veteran adventurers, I'm here to help out the rookies.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Razor's not an adventurer, and as the leader of Benny's Adventure Team as well as the only actual member, I had to come on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: But now I've been stuck here for so long, I've probably missed it... I hope Cyrus doesn't get mad at me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you're leading rookies, too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh... Wait, so that guy Gerald, who got left in the lurch — he was supposed to be paired up with you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If so... sorry, Bennett, but you really did miss it. He got paired up with a different instructor instead.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Weren't they short on instructors? Where'd they suddenly get extras from?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A few people from the Knights of Favonius stepped up in order to help support the event. So they ended up with more instructors than students.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Knights of Favonius... Yeah, they're definitely more reliable than me — I'm just a walking accident waiting to happen...

choices.text: Don't be like that. You're great too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, right. Anyway, that was just the situation when we last saw them, it might've changed by now. Who knows, maybe a whole load more rookies will have turned up to join in!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, after all the trouble you've gone to show up as an instructor, Paimon's sure Cyrus will put you to work.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, wait a second... Where'd Albedo go?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Albedo? You mean the alchemist from the Knights of Favonius? He's one of the instructors, too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, he just happened to be on Dragonspine. We were just with him, but then we heard you calling for help... he must have left us at some point after that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, could he have gone back to keep looking for clues?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go back to the cavern and see if he's there.

choices.text: You can't directly compare knights and adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'm sorry to trouble you. This was all my fault...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: No, I'm fine. Thank you for asking! Right now I just need to get outta here... Brrrr, I'm so cold... Achoo!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Thanks! I'll be, uh, waiting right here!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: From the entrance, the footprints go that way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Grr, that thieving... thief!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The footprints lead up there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So they scaled the cliff? Okay, after them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Footprints on the snow are so hard to notice... It's so easy to lose track completely...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: That's why we have to hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? The footprints stop here?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Our thief must have jumped from the cliff. Get your wind glider ready. We're going down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, this one's not bad!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this stuff looks kinda... lackluster... is that because of the impurities, like Albedo was talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I've been absorbed in my research lately and haven't attended to the dusting... It's due for a cleaning.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, so much clutter... We're not gonna find the key here, surely?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh, we got company!
